description: China's applied import tariff for a 6-digit HS code from the World Bank WITS tariff database (UNCTAD TRAINS, as reported by China): MFN simple average, minimum and maximum duty rate across the national tariff lines, number of lines and the year. HS-6 level, not the 8/10-digit China customs line; VAT, consumption tax and retaliatory surcharges are not included. Another reporting country can be chosen with its ISO numeric code. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

reporter.description: Optional ISO numeric country code of the importer (default 156 = China), e.g. 392 Japan, 356 India
